title: Astrolabe of Umar ibn Yusuf ibn Umar ibn Ali ibn Rasul al-Muzaffari
repository: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York
attribution: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Edward C. Moore Collection, Bequest of Edward C. Moore, 1891
note: Brass; cast and hammered, pierced, chased, and inlaid with silver. The Met record states this object is not on view.

title: Folio from the Blue Qur'an
note: Gold and silver on indigo-dyed parchment; probably North Africa, possibly Qairawan. The Met record states this object is not on view.

title: Al-Qanun fi al-Tibb (The Canon of Medicine)
repository: Library of Congress; original resource at Yale University Library
rights: LOC reports it is unaware of copyright or other restrictions in this World Digital Library item
attribution: Library of Congress / World Digital Library; original source Yale University Library
note: Arabic and Persian copy written by Abd al-Karim al-Qutbi al-Hanafi. This is a later copy, not an autograph by Ibn Sina. The LOC viewer and item endpoints denied direct file retrieval during this build, so no substitute image is represented as a manuscript page.

title: Radd-ur-Rafaza
repository: Scanned copy surfaced via Rekhta; image documented at Wikimedia Commons
rights: Public domain in India per Commons file record
attribution: Matba Ahle Sunnat Wa Jamaat, Bareilly; source scan credited to Rekhta
note: Actual scanned title page of an early printed work attributed to Ahmad Raza Khan; not a portrait or autograph manuscript.

title: The Algebra of Mohammed Ben Musa
attribution: Edited and translated by Friedrich Rosen; Oriental Translation Fund
note: Nineteenth-century edition and translation, not a medieval manuscript or autograph.

title: An invention from the Book of Ingenious Devices
rights: Public domain per Commons file record
attribution: Copy of a work by the Banu Musa brothers, probably Ahmad
note: Collective work image; not assigned to any one brother.

title: Phases of the Moon in Opus astronomicum
rights: Public domain scan per Commons record
attribution: Carlo Alfonso Nallino’s edition, based on al-Battani
note: Modern scholarly edition, not a medieval page. Also used as clearly labeled astronomy context on al-Farghani’s profile.

title: Lunar phases in a copy of Kitab al-Tafhim
repository: Iran Parliament Library, Museum and Document Center
attribution: Iran Parliament Library, Museum and Document Center
note: Later manuscript copy, not an autograph.

title: Illuminated opening of the Canon of Medicine
rights: Public domain U.S. federal work per Commons record
note: Later copy of the Canon, not written by Ibn Sina. Also used as medical manuscript context on Ibn al-Nafis’s profile.

title: Surgical instruments in a copy of Kitab al-Tasrif
rights: Public domain per Commons file record
attribution: Source reference: H. Turner, Science in Medieval Islam
note: Later copy of al-Zahrawi’s work, not an original page from his lifetime.

title: Al-Hawi in Latin translation, MS Latin 6912
attribution: BNF, département des manuscrits latins, MS Latin 6912
note: Latin translation, not an Arabic autograph. Used as medical manuscript context on Hunayn ibn Ishaq’s profile.

title: Optics and astronomy treatise manuscript
note: Contains works by Hypsicles and Ibn al-Haytham; not a work by Thabit ibn Qurra, whose profile links this only as contextual optics evidence.

title: The Works of Geber
attribution: Printed by William Cooper; digitized by Internet Archive
note: Early modern English edition historically attributed to Geber/Jabir; authorship history is complex. Not a medieval Arabic manuscript.
